verdict.rationale: Bugbot is a SaaS code-review service, so registrable outbound webhooks for its events (e.g., review completed, bug found) are a fair axis. The evidence pack documents no such webhooks: Bugbot reacts to PR updates and comment triggers on GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket and Azure DevOps, and posts its findings as PR comments. Those comments, the git-platform integrations and Bugbot Automations rules are adjacent features or host-platform behavior, not subscribable HTTP callbacks.
